program_settings_rate_check.name: program_settings_rate_check
program_settings_rate_check.value:
("program_settings"."rate_type" = 'percent' and "program_settings"."commission_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "program_settings"."commission_fixed_minor" is null)
      or ("program_settings"."rate_type" = 'fixed' and "program_settings"."commission_fixed_minor" > 0)

program_settings_days_check.name: program_settings_days_check
program_settings_days_check.value:
"program_settings"."attribution_days" between 0 and 365
      and "program_settings"."validation_days" between 0 and 67
      and "program_settings"."holding_days" between 0 and 365

affiliate_identity_check.name: affiliate_identity_check
affiliate_identity_check.value: ("affiliate"."kind" = 'partner' and "affiliate"."user_id" is not null) or ("affiliate"."kind" = 'customer' and "affiliate"."external_id" is not null)

commission_rate_check.name: commission_rate_check
commission_rate_check.value:
("commission"."rate_type" = 'percent' and "commission"."rate_bps" between 0 and 10000 and "commission"."rate_fixed_minor" is null)
      or ("commission"."rate_type" = 'fixed' and "commission"."rate_fixed_minor" > 0 and "commission"."rate_bps" is null)

payout_item_one_source_check.name: payout_item_one_source_check
payout_item_one_source_check.value: (("payout_item"."commission_id" is not null)::int + ("payout_item"."adjustment_id" is not null)::int) = 1
